blocks.text: PLACEHOLDER NOTE — this is a stand-in to prove out the /notes template (index card, date, hook, inline images, body blocks). Replace this file's blocks with a real migrated thread, or hand over the thread text + images and it'll get built out properly.
Body blocks support paragraphs ("p") and inline images ("img", with src + optional caption) so a thread reads the same here as it does on X — charts and all.
